enhanced_cards.headline: Insider Event Coverage Gives Readers Real‑Time Industry Access
enhanced_cards.what_readers_get: Live floor insights, keynote summaries, and networking highlights you won’t find elsewhere.
enhanced_cards.why_it_matters: Events shape strategy; timely intel helps operators act before the next big announcement.
enhanced_cards.evidence_summary: Our event pieces make up about 86% of our coverage versus only 30% for competitors.

ai_discovered.headline: Deep Regulatory Analysis Keeps Operators Ahead of Policy Shifts
ai_discovered.what_readers_get: Clear breakdowns of new gambling laws, tax proposals, and compliance tools.
ai_discovered.why_it_matters: Regulatory changes can impact licensing, revenue, and risk; early insight protects business decisions.
ai_discovered.evidence: Three internal articles on Sweden’s problem‑gambling data, Uganda’s GGR tax proposal, and South Africa’s verification portal, versus limited comparable pieces from competitors.

result.strategic_summary: The portfolio positions itself as the go‑to source for actionable event intel and regulatory insight that drives strategic decisions in iGaming.

result.timing_note: ICE/iGB event planning cycles close in Q1 of the event year. Initiating outreach now (Q3 2024) gives prospects ample time to evaluate booth options, secure speaking slots, and align their product launches with the event’s marketing calendar.
